# CSI 800 (China Securities Index 000906: the CSI 300 large caps plus the CSI 500 mid caps, Shanghai `.SS` and
# Shenzhen `.SZ` A shares), net of every other list (the 188 members already in `msci_em.txt`). From the official
# constituent file (csindex.com.cn, 000906cons.xls, as of Nov 3, 2026). Added Nov 4, 2026, user's choice: an index
# rule for China A instead of a size floor (about 5,000 A shares are >= 100 M USD, 3,659 >= 500 M USD).
# Left out, the company already in through its Hong Kong line: 000063.SZ (0763.HK), 003816.SZ (1816.HK), 600362.SS (0358.HK), 600938.SS (0883.HK), 600941.SS (0941.HK), 601390.SS (0390.HK), 601865.SS (6865.HK), 601880.SS (2880.HK), 601988.SS (3988.HK), 688331.SS (9995.HK).
# `filters.merge_share_classes` keeps one line for any other A / H pair. Buying A shares from abroad goes through
# Stock Connect; CSI 300 / 500 members are mostly eligible. Statutory dividend withholding 10% (`dividend_wht.txt`).
# Refresh after each CSI semi-annual review (effective the second Friday of June and of December).
